name: openLesson
examples_zh: 为"贝叶斯推断入门"生成苏格拉底式学习计划，用有向图标出先修概念和练习节点。
开启一节音频对话式辅导课，围绕线性代数特征值连续追问并记录我的推理漏洞。
分析我提交的概率题解题过程，指出条件独立判断中的推理差距并安排下一轮提问。
examples_en: Generate a Socratic learning plan for "introductory Bayesian inference," using a directed graph for prerequisites and practice nodes.
Start an audio tutoring session on linear algebra eigenvalues, ask follow-up questions, and record my reasoning gaps.
Analyze my probability problem solution, identify gaps in conditional-independence reasoning, and plan the next questioning round.
description_zh: 苏格拉底式 AI 辅导：生成学习计划、音频对话式教学、诊断推理差距
description_en: Socratic AI tutoring: generate learning plans, audio sessions, reasoning gap analysis
